name: Mars

display.uv: Equirectangular: u=0 west seam, v=0 south; no horizontal mirror

accuracy_notes: Viking albedo mosaic preserves broad geographic regions including Tharsis/Olympus Mons region; no elevation dataset is used. Warm color enhancement and microrelief are illustrative; mapped bright poles are retained.

attribution.usage: Educational visualization; acknowledge original source; no endorsement. See NASA media guidelines and source credits.
